title: Correspondance de Pierre Bayle (édition électronique)
author: Pierre Bayle
institution: Université Jean Monnet Saint-Étienne, IHRIM (directed by Antony McKenna and Fabienne Vial-Bonacci)
notes: Critical edition of the letters sent and received by Pierre Bayle (1647-1706), with transcriptions, annotations, indexes and translations of Latin letters. The site publishes letters 1-1405 (volumes I-XI of the printed edition, 1662-1698); volumes XII-XIV (letters up to 1791 and 1706) are not online. The site mentions TEI/XML output but no files are public. The site was updated in 2025. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
